scope: Private normal Intl opt2 compile experiment and explicit wrapper control only. No product compiler/native/CLI or full-suite acceptance. Source/provider identities and real data admission are preserved.
limits: Two admitted CPUs; serial Rustc commands under the finite32GiB cloud budget.
Compiler flags are unchanged except whether incremental scratch is retained; Rustc chooses its normal defaults for each mode. No explicit codegen-unit override.
Concurrent native verification and source checks create timing noise; this is not a full-build speedup.
Retained cache remains subject to the existing low-disk prune and build admission reserve.
Normal release profiles receive no new incremental flag.
